PropertySetDef.Name: Pset_DuctFitting
PropertySetDef.Definition:
Definition from IAI: This property set is used to define the characteristics of a duct fitting. Related property sets include Pset_DuctDesignCriteria.
HISTORY: New property set in IFC Release 2.0.
ISSUES: No issues to date.

PropertyDef.Name: FittingSubType
PropertyDef.Definition: Subtype of fitting (I.e., 5-gore, pleated, stamped, etc.)
